I want to make sure my message doesn't come off as blaming. First, I’ll say, "I'm sorry you're feeling humiliated and stressed — I understand this is hard, and I'm here to help with your account ending in 1234." I’ll also clarify that while I can’t forgive principal or fees beyond standard programs, enrolling in these options may help stop additional late fees and prevent further collection issues if the plan is followed.
